name: Deep Reading
description: Choose a book that interests you and immerse yourself in the world of words
tips: Prepare a cup of tea or coffee
scientific: Reading activates multiple regions of the brain; long-term reading enhances neuroplasticity.
goalExampleEn: Read the first two chapters and create a simple mind map

name: Creative Writing
description: Free writing or story creation, let your thoughts flow naturally
scientific: Writing aids emotional regulation and cognitive processing; recommended by positive psychology as a self-exploration tool.

name: Painting
description: Express your inner world through colors and lines, enjoy the creative process
tips: Enjoy the process, not the result
scientific: Art creation activates the brain's reward circuit, promotes dopamine secretion, and enhances well-being.
goalExampleEn: Complete a small artwork, not pursuing perfection

name: Yoga Practice
description: Connect body and mind through postures and breathing
scientific: Yoga combines breathing and movement, reduces cortisol levels, and promotes parasympathetic nervous system activity.
goalExampleEn: Learn 3 new poses, focus on breathing

name: Mindfulness Meditation
description: Focus on the present moment, observe the coming and going of breath and thoughts
scientific: Mindfulness meditation can change brain structure, increase prefrontal cortex thickness, and enhance emotional regulation ability.
goalExampleEn: Stay for 10 minutes, do not judge yourself

name: Programming Learning
description: Solve a programming problem or learn a new technology
scientific: The debugging process in programming trains executive function and enhances cognitive flexibility.
goalExampleEn: Solve one specific problem or learn a new syntax

name: Cooking Creation
description: Try a new recipe, prepare a delicious meal with care
scientific: Cooking activates the senses, promotes mindfulness, and is significantly associated with improved mood.
goalExampleEn: Try a new recipe, plate with care

name: Gardening
description: Care for plants, feel the joy of life growing
scientific: Gardening reduces cortisol levels and enhances positive emotions; it is known as "nature therapy".
goalExampleEn: Care for plants for 15 minutes, observe changes

name: Music Creation/Practice
description: Practice an instrument or try to create a melody
scientific: Music training enhances connections between multiple brain regions and promotes neuroplasticity.
goalExampleEn: Practice a melody, record your feelings

name: Running/Jogging
description: Find your rhythm while running, let your thoughts flow freely
scientific: Aerobic exercise promotes BDNF (brain-derived neurotrophic factor) secretion, improving mood and cognitive function.
goalExampleEn: Jog for 20 minutes, focus on breathing rhythm
